latest_release.name: SourceIO 6.0.0
latest_release.body:
# SourceIO 6.0.0

Requires Blender 4.5 LTS or newer.

## New: Source 1 model export
Build Source 1 models in the new **SourceIO model definition** node editor and compile them with StudioMDL. Blender Source Tools is not required.
- Exports DMX or SMD geometry, QC, VMT materials and VTF textures. You can preview the export, export meshes or materials only, or export and compile in one step.
- Bodygroups, skins, LODs, collision, hitboxes, attachments (with empties you can move in the scene) and raw QC.
- Flex controllers, including stereo flexes, corrective rules and wrinkles.
- VTF output with texture operations: channel mixing, math, normal map tools, PBR to Phong.
- Only changed files are re-exported.

## New: SFM IK rig generator
Exported models can come with a ready-to-use Source Filmmaker rig. In SFM, open the model's animation set, then *Rig > rig_ik_\<model\>*.
- IK arms and legs with foot roll, FK chains (tails), constraints, and fingers with a curl slider.
- **Detect bones** sets the rig up automatically; buttons create pole targets and heel attachments.

## Import improvements
- Rewritten Source 1 shaders. On Blender 5.3+ EEVEE gets NPR Phong highlights.
- Animated VTF textures.
- Reworked animation import, with delta animations for the NLA editor (*Combine* mode).
- Better flexes: wrinkle maps, stereo balance, and a new flex controller panel.
- Map prop import is about 10× faster; skins have been reworked.
- Black Mesa and Portal 2: Community Edition support. Basic Workshop item support. HL2: Episode Two content loads correctly.
- Better entity support.
- Fixed a crash when closing Blender, missing scale on some MDLs, and broken `.ani` loading.

## Contributors
@REDxEYE, @hisprofile, @w1tcherrr


Attaching custom studiomdl with bunch of fixes https://github.com/REDxEYE/studiomdl_v2/releases/tag/2.0.0

# SourceIO
SourceIO is a Blender(4.5+) addon for importing source engine textures/models/maps
Our Discord server https://discord.gg/SF82W6aZ67

Current TODO list -> [TODO.md](TODO.md)

# Usage
In order to find the import tools you simply need to go to File>Import>Source Engine Assets
![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/786989240529059900/1143975506589515886/image.png)

# Supported formats (v5.3.0):

## Source 1
| File Type | Contents                          | Import             | Export            |
| ------    | ------                            | ------             | ------            |
| .MDL      | Model                             | :heavy_check_mark: | Model graph (native DMX/SMD; StudioMDL) |
| .BSP      | Map Files (Compiled)              | :heavy_check_mark: | Not Planned       |
| .VMF      | Map Files (Hammer Format)         | Not Planned        | Not Planned       |
| .VTF      | Textures                          | :heavy_check_mark: | :heavy_check_mark: |
| .VMT      | Materials                         | :heavy_check_mark: | Model graph |

## Source 2
| File Type | Contents                          | Import              | Export       |
|-----------| ------                            |---------------------|--------------|
| .VMDL     | Model                             | :heavy_check_mark:  | Not Planned  |
| .VMAP     | Map Files (Compiled)              | :heavy_check_mark:  | Not Planned  |
| .VMAP     | Map Files (Hammer Format)         | Not Planned         | Not Planned  |
| .VTEX     | Textures                          | :heavy_check_mark:  | :x:          |
| .VMAT     | Materials                         | :heavy_check_mark:  | :x:          |

## Supported games
| Game      | Status                                                                                          |
|-----------| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| CSGO              | Partial support: models, maps(not all entities), textures, materials                    | 
| TF2               | Full support                                                                            |
| Source FilmMaker  | Full support                                                                            |
| Garry's Mod       | Full support                                                                            |
| HL2 and episodes  | Full support                                                                            |
| Portal 1/2        | Full support                                                                            |
| L4D2              | Full support(expect infected materials)                                                 | 
| Vindictus         | Partial support: (models, maps(not all entities), textures, materials(not all shaders)  | 
| BlackMesa         | Full support                                                                            |
| Titanfall 1       | Partial support: maps(not all entities), models, textures, materials                    |
| Counter Strike 2  | Partial support: (models, maps(not all entities), textures, materials(not all shaders, require blender 3.4 or newer)  |
| Half-Life: Alyx   | Partial support: (models, maps(not all entities), textures, materials(not all shaders)  |
| S&BOX             | Partial support: Waiting for full release                                               |
| Aperture Desk Job | Partial support: (models, maps(not all entities), textures, materials(not all shaders)  |
